name: Politics
overview: Scripture reveals that political authority is ultimately ordained and directed by God, who sets up and removes kings according to His wisdom and understanding. When rulers are righteous and acknowledge the Lord, their nations prosper and the people rejoice, but wicked leadership brings sorrow and corruption. The Bible warns against leaders who listen to lies, as this leads to widespread wickedness among their servants, emphasizing the importance of godly governance. Compassion for the vulnerable is also mandated, reflecting that just leadership must care for the poor and needy within the community.
